title: The journal
subtitle: Chapter 9 of 9
instructions: Warm and plain spoken, like a friend showing you their app. Brisk and light on its feet, keeping things moving, but never rushed or clipped. No salesy lift at the end of sentences.

lines.text: Everything you write down lives in one place: notes from your matches, lessons from your coach, and your own practice entries.
You can type an entry or hold the microphone and just talk it through, which is easier straight after you have played.
Take a picture of a page from your paper notebook and PongLens reads the writing off it, so what you scribbled becomes text you can search.
Paste in the transcript of a coaching session and it gets boiled down to the handful of things that lesson was really about.
The short list of what you are working on stays pinned at the top until you tick something off.
Recollect then reads back what you wrote and asks you about it weeks later, when you would otherwise have quietly forgotten it.
Tapping a card shows the cue in the words you saved it in, and keeping one puts it back on your list.
